# WJPMR - World Journal of Pharmaceutical and Medical Research

> A UGC-compliant, peer-reviewed open-access journal publishing pharmaceutical and medical research with double-blind peer review and international indexing.

WJPMR is a monthly publication following UGC guidelines, indexed across multiple databases including Google Scholar, Web of Science Group, and Index Copernicus. The journal is managed by the Society for Advance Healthcare Research and maintains ISO 9001:2015 certification.

## Key Topics

- Peer-reviewed journal
- Pharmaceutical research
- Medical research

## Getting Started

- [WJPMR Homepage](https://www.wjpmr.com): Main portal for WJPMR, a peer-reviewed pharmaceutical and medical research journal
- [Current Issues](https://www.wjpmr.com/current-issues): Latest published issues with article abstracts and pharmaceutical research
- [From Editor Desk](https://www.wjpmr.com/from-editor-desk): Editor's message and insights about WJPMR journal operations and vision

## Manuscript Submission & Guidelines

- [Submit Manuscript](https://www.wjpmr.com/submit-manuscript): Manuscript submission portal and process for WJPMR authors
- [Author Instructions](https://www.wjpmr.com/author-instruction): Comprehensive guidelines for manuscript submission and author requirements
- [Review Procedure](https://www.wjpmr.com/review-procedure): Detailed explanation of WJPMR's double-blind peer review process
- [Publication Ethics](https://www.wjpmr.com/publication-ethics): Publication ethics standards, author duties, and editorial responsibilities
- [Copyright Form](https://www.wjpmr.com/copyright-form): Copyright assignment form and requirements for published articles

## Journal Management & Editorial

- [Editorial Board](https://www.wjpmr.com/editorial-board): WJPMR editorial board members and journal management structure
- [Join As Reviewer](https://www.wjpmr.com/join-as-reviewer): Information for researchers to join WJPMR as peer reviewers

## Author Support & Services

- [Track Article](https://www.wjpmr.com/track-articles): Tool for authors to track article status and peer review progress
- [Processing Fees](https://www.wjpmr.com/processing-fees): Publication fees and payment methods for article processing
- [Contact Us](https://www.wjpmr.com/contact-us): Contact information and support channels for WJPMR inquiries

## Research & Archives

- [Archive](https://www.wjpmr.com/archive): Archive of past journal issues and published research articles
